body:
Implements ticket 0002. DOIfetch now consults the user's local Zotero library before downloading and skips papers already held — enabled by default whenever a Zotero database is found.

## Problem
The only dedup was a filesystem check in each fetcher, keyed on the cleaned **title** in `PAPERS_DIR`. A paper already in Zotero (but not in `PAPERS_DIR`) was refetched, and a title mismatch defeated the check even for DOIfetch's own prior downloads.

## Change
- **`zotero.py`** (new): `find_zotero_db()` locates the SQLite DB (`ZOTERO_DB_PATH` override → `ZOTERO_DATA_DIR` → standard locations → `profiles.ini`); `zotero_lookup(doi, title, db_path)` matches by DOI (case-insensitive, authoritative) with a near-exact title fallback (Jaccard ≥ 0.85).
- Read-only access (`immutable=1`) — safe while Zotero is running. Every failure path (missing / locked / corrupt DB) degrades to "no hit", never raising into the fetch loop.
- **`fetch.py`**: pre-fetch check in `_fetch_one` short-circuits to `"skipped"` before any source runs; threaded through the worker pool and the single-download path. Auto-enabled on detection; `--no-check-zotero` disables it. Reuses the existing `"skipped"` status (logs/summaries unchanged), tagged `in Zotero (doi)`.
- **README**: documents the feature and `ZOTERO_DB_PATH`.

## Behavior when off
No DB found (and no override), or `--no-check-zotero`: byte-for-byte the previous behavior.

## Tests
`tests/test_zotero.py` — DOI hit/miss, case-insensitivity, title fallback + threshold, missing/broken DB, DB discovery, and two `_fetch_one` integration tests (hit short-circuits with no source called; miss falls through to the source). Full suite: 46 passed, 1 skipped (network); ruff clean. Verified end-to-end via the CLI against a fixture DB.

**Ticket:** tickets/0002-check-zotero-library-before-fetching-to.erg

commits.messageBody:
DOIfetch previously deduped only against its own PAPERS_DIR, keyed on the
cleaned title, so a paper already in the user's Zotero library was
refetched and any title mismatch defeated the check even for its own
prior downloads.

Add zotero.py: locate the Zotero SQLite DB (ZOTERO_DB_PATH override,
ZOTERO_DATA_DIR, standard locations, profiles.ini) and look up a paper by
DOI (case-insensitive, authoritative) with a near-exact title fallback.
Reads are read-only (immutable=1) so the check is safe while Zotero runs,
and every failure path (missing/locked/corrupt DB) degrades to "no hit"
rather than raising into the fetch loop.

Wire a pre-fetch check into fetch._fetch_one so a hit short-circuits to
"skipped" before any source runs. Auto-enabled whenever a DB is found;
--no-check-zotero forces it off. Reuses the existing "skipped" status so
logs and summaries are unchanged, tagging the reason (in Zotero (doi)).

Ticket: tickets/0002-check-zotero-library-before-fetching-to.erg

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
